brief: The canvas displays a collection of interlocking, irregularly shaped pieces, each bearing a fragment of a single image, assembled into a puzzle grid. The pieces rest on a solid, flat background. The viewer interacts with the puzzle by clicking and dragging the individual pieces. When a piece is selected and moved, it can be dragged across the canvas. The goal is to position the pieces so that the corresponding edges fit together, snapping into place when correctly aligned, forming the complete picture.

statement: This sketch implements an interactive jigsaw puzzle where users can drag and position pieces to form a complete image. Each piece is a rectangle containing a visual fragment of the overall picture, positioned irregularly on the canvas. When a user clicks and drags a piece, it moves freely until released, at which point it snaps into place if it's near its correct grid position. The puzzle uses a simple grid-based snapping mechanism to guide users toward completing the image. The visual design emphasizes clarity with contrasting colors and clear edges, making the interactive elements obvious while maintaining an aesthetic balance between functionality and form.
